result.title: ISBC: Interpretable Sparse Binary Coding of Pretrained Text Embeddings
result.summary: Pretrained text embeddings encode semantic structure in high-dimensional continuous spaces whose coordinates are difficult to interpret. We introduce Interpretable Sparse Binary Coding (ISBC), which learns a small set of binary dimensions from frozen embeddings without taxonomy labels or downstream outcomes. A trainable encoder and affine decoder combine reconstruction with controls on activity, factor utilization, dependence, and activation uncertainty. Individual bits and their conjunctions select overlapping document groups; complete activation profiles provide finer contexts for conditional comparisons. We evaluate these representations across corpora, backbones, and code configurations through reconstruction, geometry, predictive probes, and document inspection. Empirical cases identify both distinctions within existing categories and shared content across their boundaries. In a mixed-domain corpus, the most frequent profiles predominantly identify source collections, while selected within-source comparisons reveal sentiment and migration contrasts. Selected associations persist in additional documents encoded without refitting. In an engagement application, bits alone improve prediction of log-transformed outcomes over a constant reference, while their combinations identify within-event content contrasts associated with engagement. The results support using binary coordinates and their combinations for empirical interpretation, with complete profiles providing a fine, partly initialization-dependent description rather than a unique discrete taxonomy.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 ISBC，从冻结的预训练文本嵌入中学习少量可解释的二值维度：用一个可训练编码器与仿射解码器，在重构目标之外加入激活稀疏度、因子利用率、依赖性和激活不确定性约束，并用重构、几何、预测探针与文档检查在多语料、多骨干上评估这些位及其组合的含义。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稀疏二值瓶颈＋因子利用率与依赖性正则」的做法，可能为 latent 推理状态中的信息坍缩诊断、离散状态可用性以及 latent 表示的可解释核查提供借鉴线索，但该文不涉及视觉输入与推理期状态生成，需人工评估迁移可行性。
